<div class="card-body">
'''Jawa''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ジャワ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊敵味方のフォースデッキから、１フォースずつ消費して、配備する。さもなければ、配備できない。タトゥイーンにのみ配備する。他の星系へ移動することはできる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-182o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">小柄でネズミを連想させる屑拾い種族。ドロイドを応急修理して売り飛ばす。サンドクローラーに住みついている。たいていの種族に、忌み嫌われる存在である。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Jawa.

'''Card text:''' * To deploy, use 1 Force from each player's Force Pile. Cannot deploy otherwise. Deploy only on Tatooine. May move to other systems.

'''Lore:''' A small, rodent-like scavenger species. They patch up droids and sell them. They nest in sandcrawlers. Most species regard them as pests.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Jawa (Dark) (Premiere)|Jawa]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
